verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents 'triggers' that automatically draft replies, add comments, or organize threads on email arrival, plus custom AI filters that let users write plain-English rules to auto-label/star/archive — directly matching event-triggered automation rules. However, this is entirely first-party changelog/blog content with no independent or hands-on verification of reliability, rule complexity, or edge cases. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of triggers working reliably in practice, detail on rule expressiveness (conditions, multi-step logic), and any community confirmation of the automation feature.
